name: How much does a room addition cost in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room addition cost in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition in Berkeley varies widely based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes. A basic addition might start around $50,000, while a larger, more complex project with high-end finishes could easily exceed $150,000. It's essential to get detailed estimates from licensed contractors that include all aspects of the project, from design and permits to construction and finishing touches. Factors like site accessibility and existing home conditions can also impact the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room addition costs in Berkeley vary greatly, typically ranging from $50,000 to over $150,000 depending on project specifics.
